title: Norse Atlantic's Planes Get Snatched Mid-Air, Two American Jets Swap Paint at Reagan, and Delta's Ghost Airline Tails
summary: Norse Atlantic's collapse gets a wild final chapter as lessors repossess planes literally mid-flight. Two American Airlines 737s collide on a DCA taxiway and force a go-around, Italy almost guts its busiest airport's schedule over EU border chaos, and we explain why some Delta jets are still wearing a dead airline's name. Plus, an update on the Qantas-Boeing widebody drama we've been watching all week.
